title: Terraform module: VPC portal subnet tiler + egress stitcher with safe upgrades and health probes
creator: Priya Kaur
description: Background: Private deployments require repeatable, safe VPC topology provisioning across accounts and AZs. Current Terraform modules cover subnet and egress patterns but lack a single opinionated module that: (1) tiles subnets per AZ with role-based patterns, (2) wires NAT/IGW per-az with autoscaling hooks, (3) stitches VPC endpoints and route tables automatically, and (4) provides upgrade-safe lifecycle hooks and health probes for safe rollouts. Goal: implement a composable Terraform module (vpc-portal) that acts as a 'portal' between account-level infra and workload stacks. The module should expose intent-driven inputs (subnet patterns, endpoint policy map, egress topology), create deterministic route tables and endpoints, run synthetic health probes for endpoint and egress reachability, emit structured telemetry for Console, and provide safe upgrade/canary hooks for rolling changes. Deliverables: Terraform module sources, example environments (single-AZ, multi-AZ), upgrade guide, integration tests, and a lightweight operator script to run health reconciliation in CI/CD.
acceptance_criteria: Module can provision AZ-aware subnet tiling based on declarative patterns (public/app/db) and outputs stable subnet IDs
Route table and egress placement created deterministically with option for centralized NAT vs per-subnet NAT/IGW
Module auto-creates and configures VPC endpoints (S3, ECR, SecretsManager) with optional endpoint policies and private DNS toggles
Synthetic health probes validate: endpoint DNS resolution, endpoint TCP reachability, NAT egress path and route table propagation; failures produce signals to Console telemetry
Upgrade process supports canary change window: create new route table/attachment -> run probes -> switch routes -> drain old resources, with a rollback path
Outputs include telemetry-friendly metadata: per-subnet tags, monitoring endpoints, and recommended batching/cache knobs for runtime placement
All new TF code is covered by unit/integration tests in CI and documented in the Private Deploy runbook
tasks: Design module API and inputs/outputs (owners: Priya/Dan)
Implement subnet tiler with AZ affinity and role labels
Implement egress stitcher: NAT gateway autoscale hooks, IGW option, elastic IP management
Implement VPC endpoint manager with endpoint policy templating and IAM role bindings
Add route table generator and deterministic naming scheme
Add synthetic health probe resources (Lambda or external probe runner) and probe definitions
Implement upgrade hooks: canary route attach/detach, probe validation, rollback automation
Add examples: single-az dev, multi-az production, high-throughput egress pattern
Write integration tests and CI pipelines for plan/apply/upgrade scenarios
Create docs: usage, upgrade guide, troubleshooting, telemetry integration
